title: Authoritative role-store synchronization, reconciliation, and SSO harmonization for RBAC v2
creator: Aisha Menon
description: Purpose: migrate customer authorization state from legacy RBAC v1 to the new RBAC v2 authoritative role store with zero data loss, continuous audit logging, and SSO/SAML mapping preservation. This ticket covers the dual-sync approach (live mirror of writes to both stores), an incremental backfill strategy with reconciliation metrics, a phased cutover plan with canaries and admin controls, and a customer communication template.
acceptance_criteria: All new authorizations are written to RBAC v2 in mirror mode with no increase in write latency above the SLA baseline
Backfill completes and reconciliation shows <0.01% discrepancies for role bindings across sampled accounts
SSO/SAML attribute mappings are preserved and validate successfully against 10 representative customer configurations
Audit logs contain immutable, correlated events (v1 and v2 IDs) for every authorization change across the migration window
Operational runbook exists with clear rollback gates and a verified rollback test in staging
tasks: Design dual-sync proxy that forks authorization writes to RBAC v1 and RBAC v2 (feature-flagged)
Implement non-blocking backfill worker that consumes role-change snapshots and writes to v2 with idempotency
Add reconciliation pipeline producing per-account diff metrics and alert thresholds in Console
Extend audit log schema with v2_role_change_id and correlation_id fields and validate ingestion
Create canary cohort selection logic (10 internal orgs + shadow external customers) and gating metrics
SAML/SSO mapping validator: integration tests for SAML attribute->role mapping equivalence
Admin console controls: dry-run toggle, force-sync endpoint, reconciliation override with audit trail
Prepare customer communication templates, FAQ, and scheduled maintenance windows
comments: 2026-02-26 - Aisha Menon: Initial design reviewed with security and infra. Agreed on forked write proxy instead of client-side dual-write to reduce client changes and centralize observability.

2026-03-02 - Luca Bennett: Prototype dual-sync proxy implemented. Basic benchmark shows 3% p99 write latency increase; added async telemetry batching to bring impact down. Open questions: migration of role UUIDs vs names for correlation.
2026-03-05 - Priya Shah (Security): Requested explicit correlation_id in audit logs for tamper-evidence. Decided to embed source_trace (v1/v2) and sign the log payloads for critical ops.

2026-03-08 - QA: Backfill worker tested on staging dataset (50k accounts). Observed 0.18% idempotency collisions due to concurrent admin edits; fixed by adding last-write-timestamp reconciliation and retry window.
2026-03-10 - PM review (Ethan Cole): Customer comms reviewed. Recommended adding a non-disruptive opt-out window and pre-migration readiness checks surfaced in Console.

2026-03-12 - Oncall & SRE sync: Reconciliation pipeline alert thresholds set. Pager duty runbook drafted with three levels: discrepancy-warning, elevated-reconciliation, immediate-rollforward/fallback.
operational_notes: Feature-flag controls: 'rbac_v2_dual_sync' (proxy mode), 'rbac_v2_backfill' (workers), 'rbac_v2_cutover' (traffic switch). Canary windows are 72 hours with automated drift checks every 30 minutes. Rollback gates: sustained discrepancy >0.05% for 4 checks OR any SSO mapping failures affecting customer auth flows.
rollback_plan: Step 1: Flip feature flag to stop writing to RBAC v2 (proxy serves single write to v1). Step 2: Pause backfill workers and trigger reconciliation to understand outstanding writes. Step 3: Notify customers and resume normal ops. Step 4: If discrepancy persists, run targeted rollbacks on affected orgs and open incident. Full rollback validated in staging before production cutover.
risk_matrix: Risks: SAML mapping drift (high), audit log correlation gaps (medium), write latency regression (medium), data loss in backfill edge cases (low). Mitigations: mapping validator, signed audit events, async telemetry batching, idempotent backfill with LWT-based retries.
customer_communication: Planned email and in-console banner two weeks prior, including: migration overview, what customers should expect (no action required unless using custom SAML mappings), scheduled maintenance windows, opt-out grace period, and contact for support. Template saved to Confluence link above.
post_migration_checks: Daily reconciliation delta trending below 0.01% for 7 consecutive days
No SSO/SAML customer support tickets related to role mapping within 72 hours after cutover
Audit logs show correlated v1/v2 events for 100% of authorization writes during migration window
Cost delta for authorization writes within <5% of baseline after optimization
